messages:
erin_sales: SentryHealth needs a HIPAA POC. They project baseline ~250 qps, morning 10m window spikes to ~900 qps (avg ~75 tokens). Ask: reserved sizing, preheat plan, autoscale snippet, and a p99 SLA we can include in the SOW. Need by EOD tomorrow.

zane_eng: Quick calc: at ~75 tokens, our A100-x node does ~275 qps/GPU. 900 peak -> reserve 4 GPUs (gives ~1100 capacity) but 3 could work with burst credits. Recommend reserved=4 for margin.

maya_sre: Agree on 4 reserved. KV shards = 8 (2 per GPU). Preheat 18m before spikes to warm weights + KV. AZ spread: 2 AZs minimum for HA.

chris_prod: Fallback plan: smaller quantized model (gpt-lite-int8) to preserve availability. Routing priority: reserved -> burst_pool -> degraded_model. We'll attach quality checks.

olivia_ops: Ops knobs: global_rate_limit: 1200qps, max_queue_depth: 400. Add rate-based shedding and backpressure. Preheat command for docs: `redwood preheat --project sentry-poc --model gpt-med-quant --shards 8 --duration 18m --warm_weights true`

zane_eng: Short autoscale YAML snippet for SOW (pasteable):

autoscale:
  reserved_gpus: "4"
  burst_pool: "2"
  preheat_minutes: "18"
  kv_shards: "8"
  az_spread: "2"
  scale_up_policy: "target_util:60%, cooldown_s:15"
  scale_down_policy: "grace_period_s:180"
  degraded_model: "gpt-lite-int8"

maya_sre: SLA blurb we can use: "Redwood commits to p99 < 250ms when serving from reserved capacity (reserved_gpus=4) with KV warmed and no eviction. If serving from burst_pool or degraded_model, p99 may increase to 350-600ms. This POC SLA is conditional and subject to SOW terms."

erin_sales: Legal asks for KMS and BAA language; can we confirm KMS envelope support and audit log retention?

legal_ravi: We support customer-managed KMS (envelope) and audit logs >=90 days for the POC. I need their security questionnaire; forward it and I'll mark required items. Also note: SLA language must include the caveat about eviction and burst fallbacks.

olivia_ops: Runbook triggers: if p99 > 300ms for 90s -> pager and scale-check; if sustained > 400ms for 2m -> auto-roll to degraded_model and notify customer. Manual override available to disable preheat.

chris_prod: We'll add telemetry: sample prompt/responses during fallback to detect quality regression and rollback if regression > X%.

preheat-bot: Preheat placeholder scheduled: sentry-poc / preheat / 2024-11-20T07:42Z :white_check_mark: 

erin_sales: Perfect. I'll include reserved_gpus:4, burst_pool:2, preheat:18m, SLA blurb, runbook, and legal notes in the SOW draft. Thanks everyone :tada:
